@everyone 

Here is another team update! As always you can check in on the WIKI page on the monthly status section as well. 

cNFTCon
We are a short few days away from all gathering in Las Vegas! The team is super excited for the opportunity to meet our community members, and other Cardano project teams! I do believe that we will be breaking the golden rule of Vegas, “what happens in Vegas, stays in Vegas”. We will be sharing as much content as possible from the showroom floor to alleviate the FOMO factor for those of you who could not make it!

Game Development
Since my last team update, we have accomplished quite a bit on the game development side. Our massive racing map was successfully migrated over to UE5. Additionally, the track was upgraded with a few cosmetic changes and is ready for cNFTCon attendees to demo. As you have seen through a few recent leaks, Solace is continually being sculpted with more and more detail (more trees, shrubs, flowers, etc). We also have continued to make strides with multiplayer functionality which will be showcased during cNFTCon. Epic stuff!!

Bridge
Wen bridge? We can definitively say that the BSC to Cardano bridge is very close to being ready. Due to the nature of the subject, we will not be providing any advice on what you SHOULD do, only HOW to bridge if you plan on doing so. We will be releasing detailed instructions on this soon (shortly after cNFTCon).

COPI Token
Our development team has confirmed that COPI is now functioning as a form of payment on the Cornucopias Marketplace! We will soon be testing this as a team and will continue to update on its progress.  As previously mentioned this will be utilized with the Collectors Club which features partnerships with Cardano ecosystems projects.  And finally, it will be a great added utility for the Copi token. 

Gamification of Education
We have officially kicked off a working relationship with our Ukraine development team and are busy building out the education platform that will be offered to our community. While this concept is still young, we plan to offer all sorts of achievements and badges that will come with a variety of perks. 

Dashboard 
The second phase of our development project with the Ukrainian team will involve a dashboard for our community. We aim to provide as much information about tokenomics, staking, NFTs, etc so that you can track all the important information you need. If you have suggestions on features, please feel free to drop them in the #suggestions channel!

Suggestions Channel
Over the next few months our team will be distraction free. No sales, no conferences (aside from Josh and Rob at the Cardano Summit and Crypto A.M. awards), JUST BUILDING. We will continue to double down on a variety of projects to bring all of our community members value. To that point, I want to emphasize that we want you all to continue to gather your suggestions and voice your opinions, ideas, concerns in our suggestions channel. On top of that, I would like to ask that if you see a suggestion that you like, please upvote it with a STAR emoji. If the suggestion earns 5 stars, it will be reposted in the newly created #upvoted-suggestions channel. This will help the team filter through the chatter and pinpoint what the community wants. And to be clear, this does not mean we will stop reading the suggestions channel!

@everyone 

Cornucopians, 

Thank you for being so patient for this moment. The bridge to Cardano is now officially open. Here is what you need to know… 

This is the first of it’s kind, so please be aware of that as you go through this process. Chainport has worked extensively with the IOG bridge team. It is important to note that the way Chainport has structured the bridge is to allow 1 transaction per block.

IMPORTANT: There will be a 5,000 COPI minimum in order to port to Cardano.

Here are the instructions on how to bridge from BSC to Cardano:

1. Go to https://www.chainport.io/

2. Hit "Launch App" in top right corner

3. Connect your wallet and make sure you are on BNB Chain - IF your tokens are on a ledger wallet, please use the “Connect Hardware Wallet” feature within MetaMask. DO NOT use the Ledger connect option in the wallet popup.

4. In the drop down, select Port your COPI Tokens from BNB Chain to Cardano

5. Enter the amount of tokens you wish to port

6. Enter your Cardano wallet address as the "Recipient address”

7. Approve Spending 

8. Port your COPI Tokens from BSC to Cardano

For a video on the process, you can watch here:

https://youtu.be/j9M5WbGt5JU
